title: 대도시권광역교통위원회 직제 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 5 (Metropolitan Transportation Management Office)
① The Director of the Metropolitan Transportation Management Office shall be a general civil servant within the senior civil servant cadre, with a job grade of Grade 2.
② The Metropolitan Transportation Management Office shall have the Departments of Metropolitan Policy and Transportation, and Metropolitan Intermodal, with each department head being a Deputy Director or a Scientific and Technical Officer or a Clerk. <Amended February 22, 2022, August 30, 2023>
③ The Director of the Department of Metropolitan Policy shall be responsible for the following matters: <Amended February 22, 2022>
1. Matters related to the construction and operation of metropolitan transportation facilities.
2. The establishment and improvement of policies related to metropolitan transportation facilities.
3. The establishment of annual metropolitan transportation investment plans and adjustment of investment priorities.
4. Support for pre-feasibility studies for metropolitan transportation facilities.
5. Matters related to conflict resolution and management regarding the operation plans, financial sharing, etc. of metropolitan transportation facilities.
6. Matters related to the support of metropolitan urban rail and metropolitan rail projects.
7. Approval of the establishment, modification of the basic plan and business plan for urban rail and metropolitan rail by line in metropolitan areas.
8. Budget for metropolitan urban rail and metropolitan rail.

Overall Coordination and Management

9. Matters related to the rapid transit of urban railways and regional railways within metropolitan areas.
10. Matters related to the establishment and modification of train operation plans for urban railways and regional railways within metropolitan areas.
11. Matters related to the establishment and management of vehicle supply plans for urban railways and regional railways within metropolitan areas.
12. Matters related to the designation of sections for regional railways.
13. Matters related to the sharing of costs for the construction and improvement of regional railways.
14. Management of regulations related to the handling of regional railway business.
15. Matters related to consultations on the issuance of urban railway bonds and the delegation of urban railway construction projects.
16. Matters related to support for the improvement of management of urban railways.
17. Supervision and implementation of necessary orders for urban railway constructors and operators.
17.2. Development and introduction of tram (streetcar) and tram-train systems.
17.3. Establishment and operation of design guidelines for urban railway stations and transfer/convenience facilities.
18. Matters related to international cooperation and overseas technology collaboration in the field of regional and urban railways.
19. Matters related to improving the regional transportation environment for people with disabilities in metropolitan areas.
20.

Overall responsibility for research and development of environmentally friendly future transportation technologies, as well as the development of long-term plans for metropolitan areas, including:

④ The Director of the Metropolitan Transportation Division is responsible for the following:

1.  Development and improvement of policies and regulations related to rapid bus systems, metropolitan roads, and congested traffic roads.
2.  Development and implementation of a comprehensive plan for the rapid bus system.
3.  Development and implementation of a plan for improving congested traffic roads.
4.  Matters related to the construction, operation, and management of the rapid bus system.
5.  Establishment of technical standards for the rapid bus system facilities.
6.  Matters related to the technological development and enhancement of services for the rapid bus system.
7.  Matters related to the development and approval of a plan for the rapid bus system.
8.  Matters related to the development and approval of an implementation plan for the rapid bus system, metropolitan roads, and congested traffic roads.
9.  Matters related to the allocation of project costs for the rapid bus system, metropolitan roads, and congested traffic roads among relevant agencies.
10. Matters related to the allocation of budgets for the rapid bus system, metropolitan roads, and congested traffic roads, as well as national funding support for local governments.
11.

Execution and management of construction projects related to express bus systems, regional roads, and congested roads.
12. Matters related to the maintenance and improvement of express bus system construction projects.
13. Matters related to the feasibility review of introducing an express bus system when constructing a regional road.
14. Establishment of standards for calculating the transportation capacity of an express bus system.
15. Guidance and supervision of express bus system operators.
16. Matters related to the license and licensing criteria for express bus system operations.
17. Matters related to the optimization of express bus system operations and the installation of auxiliary facilities.
18. Matters related to international cooperation and overseas technology cooperation regarding express bus systems, regional roads, and congested roads.
19. Matters related to the introduction and support of new transportation systems such as autonomous driving in express bus systems.
20. Matters related to the introduction and support of environmentally friendly systems such as hydrogen in express bus systems.
21. Matters related to the construction of regional road networks linked with public transportation facilities.
⑤ The Regional Transit Director is responsible for the following matters: <amended February 22, 2022>
1. Transit centers and

1. Development and improvement of policies related to transfer centers
2. Overall planning for the establishment of transfer centers and integrated transfer centers
3. Matters related to the construction, operation, and management of transfer centers and integrated transfer centers
4. Development of guidelines for the development of integrated transfer centers
5. Development and implementation of guidelines for the development of integrated transfer centers
6. Development and implementation of design and placement standards for transfer centers and integrated transfer centers
7. Matters related to designation, approval, and revocation of integrated transfer centers
8. Development and implementation of guidelines for the management of integrated transfer centers
9. Matters related to the allocation of budgets for transfer centers and integrated transfer centers, and national subsidies to local governments
10. Matters related to the development of integrated transfer centers and the preparation of implementation plans for development projects
11. Matters related to the implementation and management of construction for integrated transfer centers
12. Matters related to the maintenance and improvement of facilities for integrated transfer centers
13. Matters related to the support for pilot projects for the development of integrated transfer centers
14. Matters related to improving transfer routes and connecting transportation systems at bus stops and train stations

Items related to the installation, maintenance, and establishment of standards for comprehensive bus transfer facilities and related infrastructure.

15. Items related to the installation and operation of convenience and safety facilities in transfer centers and multi-transfer centers.
16. Items related to the construction and operation of environmentally friendly vehicle transfer centers.
17. Items related to the construction and support of bus information systems and transfer information systems in metropolitan areas.
18. Items related to international cooperation and overseas technology collaboration for transfer centers and multi-transfer centers.
19. Items related to the development support of areas surrounding transfer centers and multi-transfer centers.
20. Items related to the operation of the "pre-assessment of transfer convenience" system.
21. Items related to the operation of the overall planning unit for transfer centers.
